Highlights:
ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 3070 AMP Holo

ZT-A30700F-10P

Get Amplified with the ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX™ 30 Series based on the NVIDIA Ampere architecture. Built with enhanced RT Cores and Tensor Cores, new streaming multiprocessors, and high-speed GDDR6 memory, the ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 3070 AMP Holo gives rise to amplified gaming with high fidelity in style.
